Report this job About Siemens Healthineers At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our purpose is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, reliable, and intelligent technologies that improve patient outcomes and make healthcare more accessible. By combining advanced medical devices, intelligent software, and modern engineering practices, we build solutions that address real-world healthcare challenges while ensuring sustainability and long-term impact. As AI transforms the way software is engineered and experienced, we are looking for AI-Native Software Developers who can leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle while building secure, scalable, and intelligent healthcare applications. Role Overview As an AI-Native Software Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software while effectively leveraging AI to accelerate engineering productivity and enhance software capabilities. You will integrate AI-powered services into applications, validate AI-generated outputs, and apply responsible AI principles to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable healthcare solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative products while continuously adopting emerging AI technologies and modern engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Analyze business and technical requirements and identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities where they add value. Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions using modern engineering practices. Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity while validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation. Integrate AI-powered features, services, or intelligent agents into applications using enterprise AI platforms and context engineering principles. Ensure software quality, reliability, and performance through automated testing, continuous delivery, and validation of AI-enabled features. Apply secure coding and responsible AI practices to ensure privacy, compliance, and trustworthy AI solutions. Collaborate across global teams and continuously adopt emerging technologies to drive engineering excellence. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering/Information Technology, or related discipline. 4-7 years of experience in software development using modern engineering practices. Strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented design, and design patterns. Experience developing enterprise-scale cloud-native applications. Technical Skills Software Engineering C# , .NET / .NET Core REST APIs, Microservices Angular / React / JavaScript / TypeScript /HTML5 / CSS Cloud & DevOps Microsoft Azure (preferred) Docker / Kubernetes Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines Infrastructure as Code (desirable) AI Engineering Experience integrating AI services or Large Language Models into applications. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or equivalent). Understanding of context engineering principles for enterprise AI applications. Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and AI orchestration frameworks is desirable. Familiarity with AI evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. Software Quality Test automation TDD / BDD Secure coding Performance optimization Observability and monitoring Behavioral Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Growth mindset with passion for continuous learning. Ability to effectively collaborate across global teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to balance engineering excellence with rapid innovation. Ownership mindset and commitment to delivering customer value. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing healthcare software or regulated products. Familiarity with medical device software standards and secure software development practices. Exposure to AI agents, workflow automation, or enterprise AI platforms. Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities are an advantage. Report this job At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. We’re seeking a passionate and experienced Software Engineer focused on distributed systems to join our Observability Platform team. In this pivotal role, you will design and build scalable infrastructure that powers the telemetry, monitoring, and reliability needs of our platform teams. Our Observability platform is a hyperscaler, operating on billions of time series and petabytes of logs, and is completely built on cutting-edge open-source technologies such as Prometheus, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, and more. You will work across the stack – from data ingestion and storage to visualization – to ensure we build systems that are reliable, performant, and a joy to use. You will partner closely with world-class SREs, platform engineers, and service owners to support the development, scaling, and maintenance of mission-critical observability systems that power modern, high-scale distributed applications. Working with this team unlocks unparalleled exposure to SREs who manage eBay's site, comprising thousands of microservices. You'll be at the bleeding edge, solving observability problems that are not even a concern for most yet, contribute to open-source projects, and gain an invaluable learning experience. What You’ll Do Architect and implement scalable, fault-tolerant telemetry infrastructure with a focus on reliability and low operational overhead Build and optimize services for ingesting, transforming, and querying telemetry data such as logs, metrics, and traces Operate production-grade Kubernetes-based systems with a focus on self-healing, autoscaling, and robustness Collaborate across teams to understand observability needs and build tools that enhance operational excellence Contribute to system design reviews and post-incident retrospectives with a mindset of continuous improvement Participate in the team’s site on-call rotation to help ensure the availability and reliability of our observability systems Optionally, build user-facing interfaces to surface observability insights (using React/JavaScript) Basic Qualifications 4+ years of professional experience in full stack software development and infrastructure engineering Hands-on experience building full-stack applications using modern backend and frontend technologies Strong programming skills in Golang (or equivalent system-level languages such as Java, C++, or Python) Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into software applications using modern AI frameworks, MCP Servers and AI Agent Frameworks(LangChain, LangGraph or similar) Working knowledge of AI-assisted software development, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, AI agents, or related technologies Experience designing and consuming REST/gRPC APIs and building scalable microservices Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals including scalability, fault tolerance, consistency, and resiliency Hands-on experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments (Kubernetes) Familiarity with observability pillars - metrics, logs, traces Clear communication skills and a collaborative mindset Preferred Qualifications Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, or similar tools Exposure to time-series data storage and query optimization Strong frontend development experience using React, JavaScript/TypeScript Contributions to open-source infrastructure or observability tooling Experience with high-throughput data pipelines in cloud-native environments Frontend development using React/JavaScript Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer.
